Bone cancer ka naam sunte hi, sabse pehla darr hota hai: kya pair kaatna padega?
Aaj zyaadatar cases mein jawab hai, nahi! Iska naam hai, limb salvage surgery.
Pehle MRI aur CT scan se, tumor ka exact size aur position plan kiya jaata hai.
Surgery mein tumor ko, aas paas ke thode healthy tissue ke saath, poora nikaala jaata hai, taaki cancer peeche na chhoote.
Phir us gap ko bhara jaata hai, ek strong metal implant se, jise endoprosthesis kehte hain, ya phir bone graft se.
Zaroori nasein aur blood vessels bachaye jaate hain, taaki pair kaam karta rahe.
Chemotherapy aur physiotherapy ke saath, patient dheere dheere phir se chalna seekhta hai.
Har case alag hota hai. Sahi option ke liye, apne orthopaedic oncosurgeon se zaroor baat karein.
